scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace @lankadws/web" "npm run start:dev --workspace @lankadws/api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @lankadws/contracts && npm run build --workspace @lankadws/api && npm run build --workspace @lankadws/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @lankadws/contracts && npm run lint --workspace @lankadws/api && npm run lint --workspace @lankadws/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @lankadws/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @lankadws/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @lankadws/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @lankadws/contracts && npm run test --workspace @lankadws/api && npm run test --workspace @lankadws/web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e --workspace @lankadws/api && npm run test:e2e --workspace @lankadws/web
scripts.quality: npm ci && npm run prisma:generate && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:integration && npm run build
